title: Accept or Repair: Preserving Passage-Supported Answers in Contrastive Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.29727v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models often answer from knowledge learned during training, even when a provided passage contradicts that knowledge. To address this problem, contrastive decoding contrasts the predictions under the full and a modified prompt at every token, but it also alters correct answers that the passage supports. We show that checking answers against the passage removes this trade-off. Based on this observation, we propose Accept-or-Repair (AoR), a training-free procedure. AoR keeps a sampled answer if the passage supports it. Otherwise, it tries up to two replacements with contrastive decoding, returning one as soon as it passes this check. It rejects replacements that repeat the answer generated without the passage when the passage favors another answer. Our experiments show that AoR raises the score over sampling by 12.5 points on counterfactual passages and 2.3 on ordinary ones, surpassing eight contrastive and prompting baseline

translated_title: 接受或修复：在对比解码中保留段落所支持的答案
translated_abstract: 大语言模型常常基于训练期间学到的知识来回答问题，即使所提供的段落与该知识相矛盾。为了解决这个问题，对比解码在每个词元上对比完整提示与修改后提示下的预测，但它也会改变段落所支持的正确答案。我们证明，将答案与段落进行核对可以消除这种权衡。基于这一观察，我们提出了“接受或修复”（Accept-or-Repair, AoR）这一无需训练的方法。如果段落支持采样得到的答案，AoR 就保留该答案；否则，它会使用对比解码尝试最多两个替换答案，一旦某个替换答案通过该检查就立即返回。当段落倾向于另一个答案时，它会拒绝那些重复了在没有段落情况下所生成答案的替换。我们的实验表明，AoR 在反事实段落上比采样方法提高了 12.5 分，在普通段落上提高了 2.3 分，超越了八种对比解码与提示基线方法。
tldr: 提出无需训练的“接受或修复”（AoR）方法，通过将答案与所给段落核对来保留段落支持的答案、仅在不支持时用对比解码进行修复，在反事实段落上比采样提升 12.5 分并超越八种基线。
en_tdlr: It proposes a training-free Accept-or-Repair (AoR) procedure that verifies answers against the provided passage, keeping passage-supported answers and applying contrastive-decoding repairs only when needed, improving scores by 12.5 points on counterfactual passages and surpassing eight baselines.
